front: Turn dirt or mud into medical plaster usable in place of healer's tools for first aid and wound treatment.
back:
Plaster substitutes for healer's tools on Medicine checks to Administer First Aid or Treat Wounds.
If unused for the duration (10 min), or you Cast the Spell again first, it reverts to normal earth.
Heightened (3rd): user gets +1 item bonus to the Medicine check.
